title: Canonical 本地运行时幂等启动与真实健康诊断
user_outcome: 同一 canonical runtime 重复执行启动不会重复拉起服务、误杀未知进程或漂移端口，并能看到真实 API/代理/语音/worker 状态
current_facts: start-core.ps1 会无条件执行 pnpm dev，已有 4000/4175 监听时仍可能产生重复 worker 或端口冲突
现有脚本只对 8100 做复用判断，没有统一诊断 4000、4175 与 worker
共享演示端口固定为 API 4000、frontend 4175、speech 8100

product_alignment.p0: 真实学习证据与教师干预闭环
product_alignment.contribution: 解除 canonical runtime 不可重复启动、运行态来源不清和前后端联调不稳定阻塞
non_goals: 不修改业务 API、前端页面或数据库 schema
不自动终止任何既有或未知进程
不把健康检查冒充浏览器黄金闭环验收

minimal_tests.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用

test_evidence.name: PowerShell 语法解析
test_evidence.summary: 4/4 runtime scripts parsed without PowerShell syntax errors.

test_evidence.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用（首轮测试器误判）
test_evidence.summary: Runtime was reused twice, but the test incorrectly expected Write-Host output in the success pipeline; assertion was corrected to use health and PID stability.

test_evidence.name: canonical 运行态连续两次启动复用
test_evidence.summary: Two consecutive starts reused API PID 2960, frontend PID 10796, speech PID 32820 and worker PIDs 23900/30388; all three HTTP checks returned 200 on fixed ports. Existing duplicate worker warning was preserved and no process was stopped. Runtime build provenance remains explicitly unverified.

rollback: 回退本任务提交；脚本不终止、不重启既有进程，runtime-local 诊断 JSON 可直接删除
